immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: bind results to the repository base revision and tree
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: use only the lake-manifest pin and clean materialized source; history is a lead unless the object is an ancestor of the pin
immutable_selection_rules.external: resolve every admitted moving ref to a full commit and tree and hash each inspected source
immutable_selection_rules.exactness: compare one-sorted SimpleGraph/Cardinal or ENat candidates with the two-sorted explicit-edge Nat-attainment target and require checked transports for root credit
immutable_selection_rules.trust: separate wrapper/conclusion from terminal body; sorryAx, unelaborated source, unknown transitive closure, or error recovery gets no M0/M1 credit
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: record the searched surface, query family, date, limits, and access failures; bounded no-match never proves internet-wide absence

expected_negative_evidence: exact query family and searched immutable surface
exit or HTTP/search status and bounded result count
response/source SHA-256 when preserved, otherwise explicit nonreplayable boundary
credential, rate-limit, timeout, indexing, archive, and language-filter limitations
no saturation claim without independently reviewed saturation evidence
candidate_fields_required: candidate id, project, canonical remote, revision, tree, and license
toolchain, dependency lock, module, file, Git blob, source hash, declaration, and source type
normalized comparison to the full frozen target and every unclosed transport/existence bridge
checked wrapper/conclusion versus terminal declaration/body and proof-body location
direct/transitive dependency boundary and machine axioms when actually checked
local dependency feasibility, M and E classification, blocker, integration decision, and reopen condition
pre_protocol_inputs: The intake and statement dossiers contained bounded repo-local/mathlib probes and an immutable translated-primary-source lead. They are reclassified as leads only; no earlier absence, proof, or source-completion claim is inherited.
status_boundary: This is a bounded discovery protocol, not an exhaustive internet census, proof receipt, accepted state transition, AUDIT-Z decision, or theorem-completion decision.
